sections.title: Synthesis: The Geometry of Duality
lecture_lines: Linear functions correspond to unique vectors.
The normal vector is the function's dual.
Rotating vectors rotates the associated plane.
animations: Show linear functional as a line in #FFFFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg].

sections.title: Conclusion and Intuition
lecture_lines: Dot products measure alignment and projection.
Duality bridges directions and spatial slices.
This defines boundaries in machine learning.
